page.layout: One text column, full width; a marginal note at the left margin beside the paragraph "RHETI in his temporum"; a catchword-like running line at the foot ("Sacramenta convellant:" and "Mis-") set in italic below the last line.

main_text.l: in Ecclesiae gubernatione: M. Nicolaus Zeid-
rus, M. Elias Theodorus, Martinus Molle-
rus, Gregorius Richterus, vir literato orbi de
RHETI in his temporum & certaminu de
suis, ut miso Thoma, Scoto, Aristotele, & omni-
docerent populum, quae sacris literis essent
pore ita crevit illorum numerus: ut hoc anno
Doctorum Evangelicorum in Rhetia. Non fe-
rendum sibi hoc esse arbitrati sunt Abbas S.
Lucii, & Decanus cum Capitulo Curiensi. In
conventu igitur ante festum natalis Christi
socios haereseos graviter accusant: ut qui, Sacramenta convellant:

page.notes: Marginal note at left: "Chronicon Bullingeri M.S." The final line is a catchword-like italic line; the word "Mis-" at right is a catchword. The running head is reconstructed from "Annus M D XXV." The engraving-style ornaments and show-through are omitted. Uncertain readings: "Dorffman" in the Fraktur-like type; "Wirtwein" in black letter.
